Name: Chenaniah, Officer
Summary: Of the Izharites, with his sons, for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:29: Of the Izharites, with his sons, for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
LifeLesson: The mention of Chenaniah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
